'''FK Metalac Gornji Milanovac''' ({{Lang-sr-Cyrl|ФК Металац Горњи Милановац}}) is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Gornji Milanovac]], [[Serbia]]. They compete in the [[Serbian League West]], the third tier of the [[Serbian football league system|national league system]]."}}
